<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 18"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Call the Worm](/Feats.aspx?ID=4369) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 81

**Archetype** [Worm Caller](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=208)

**Prerequisites**
[Azure Fins](/Feats.aspx?ID=4363)

</column>

---

You gain [_summon animal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=316), heightened to 9th level, as an innate primal spell that you can cast once per day, but can only summon a [purple worm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=73). At 20th level, you can summon an [elite purple worm](/Monsters.aspx?Elite=true&ID=73) instead.
